items.title: Kyle Pitts: Uptick in production during big win
items.description:
Pitts secured all three targets for 47 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

items.title: Alvin Kamara: Two rush TDs in return to lead role
items.description:
Kamara rushed seven times for 23 yards and two touchdowns and brought in five of seven targets for 35 yards in the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Falcons on Monday night.

items.title: Brian Robinson: Racks up three TDs in win
items.description:

items.title: Michael Penix: Highly efficient in big division win
items.description:
Penix completed 15 of 20 passes for 223 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-2 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.
